description: Among the divisors of 12 ordered by divisibility, {1,2,4,12} is a chain and {4,6} is an antichain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor_chain_antichain :
  IsChain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2)
      {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 1 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 2 ⋯,
        Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 12 ⋯} ∧
    IsAntichain (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2)
      {Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯}
